## Verdict (live)
**LOCAL-WITH-MODEST-WORK — functionally working for the documentation site.** `vinext build` succeeds (EXIT 0) after a small, well-understood change set, and `vinext start` (local Node) serves the site correctly end-to-end:
- ALL sampled pages HTTP 200 with correct content (homepage, learn, reference, blog, community) after the homepage-root fix; nonexistent → 404.
- The "hard" runtime endpoints all work LOCALLY: api/md markdown, llms.txt (getServerSideProps), errors/[code] (remote codes.json fetch), `.md` rewrite, `Accept: text/markdown`.
- Client-side (headless browser): homepage hydration, client `<Link>` nav, standard `<Sandpack>` live editor + preview, and Algolia DocSearch ALL work, 0 console errors.
- ONLY the in-browser RSC Sandpack playground (the biggest re-engineering item) is unverified — its sole page is dev-only/excluded from the prod build; the build resolves it (raw-loader→?raw) but the Blob-Worker runtime wasn't exercised.

CHANGE SET (small): 4 config additions in vite.config.ts; 1 config file ESM-converted (tailwind.config.cjs→.mjs); 1 import-style change (raw-loader→?raw, 6 imports, 1 file); homepage routing split (rename catch-all + add index.js + null-safe params, 3 files). Plus the non-destructive `vinext init`. No webpack-shim re-engineering was needed for the docs site (only the unverified ESLint/RSC-playground client features would need it).

VERSION GAP (Next 15 vs vinext-16) did NOT materialize on the tested surface. Baseline `next build` (clean clone) = PASS (809 pages), so vinext failures were real port work, not pre-existing react.dev bugs.

**P7 ADVERSARIAL RE-CHECK: VERDICT SURVIVED (fully).** A fresh independent subagent (maker≠checker; did NOT read these notes) re-ran `vinext build` itself → exit 0 + "Build complete"; re-curled / (og:title "React", real homepage — not Not-Found), /learn, /reference/react/useState, /blog, /community → all 200 with matching h1/og:title; /zzz-nope → correctly 404; all four special endpoints (/llms.txt text/plain, /errors/418, /learn.md raw MDX, Accept:text/markdown raw MDX) → confirmed; server log grep for error/unhandled/ENOENT/500 → clean; headless browser on /learn → live Sandpack editor + Algolia search button present, console 0 errors. It found NO refutations — only the same non-fatal build warnings (prepareMDX default-import IMPORT_IS_UNDEFINED; direct-eval warning) plus one new note (below). Verdict confirmed.

- Optional catch-all `[[...slug]]` does not serve `/` (empty params) → 404. Worked around via required-catch-all + index.js. **Primary upstream issue.**

NOT NEEDED (anticipated as hard, but worked as-is): custom build-time MDX compiler (compileMDX), SSG over 222 .md, getStaticProps/Paths, getServerSideProps (llms.txt), api/md fs endpoint, errors remote fetch, generateRssFeed fs write, Tailwind/PostCSS, next/link|router|head|image, Algolia, standard Sandpack — all worked on local Node without source changes.

## Blockers & changes (symptom → root cause → change made → status)
All changes are in vite.config.ts unless noted. Build = `vinext build`; dev = `vinext dev`.

1. BLK-1 RESOLVED — symptom: all pages HTTP 500 `Cannot find module 'components/Layout/Page'` (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). Root cause: react.dev tsconfig `baseUrl:"src"` (bare imports `components/…`, `utils/…`, `hooks/…`) with NO `paths`; Vite has no baseUrl, and native `resolve.tsconfigPaths` doesn't cover baseUrl-only in the SSR runner. Change: `resolve.alias` mapping the 3 bare roots (components/utils/hooks) to absolute src dirs. Status: FIXED (config).

2. BLK-2 RESOLVED — symptom: dev boot `[PARSE_ERROR] Unexpected JSX expression / JSX syntax is disabled` for JSX in `.js` files (404.js, [[...markdownPath]].js, HomeContent.js, prepareMDX.js), dep-scan fails. Root cause: react.dev keeps JSX in `.js`; Vite 8 optimizeDeps scanner has JSX off for `.js`. Change: `optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions.moduleTypes {'.js':'jsx'}`. Status: FIXED for the dev scanner (config). NOTE: build path doesn't need it (vinext's oxc transform already handles JSX-in-.js for SSR/build).

3. BLK-6 RESOLVED — symptom: build `[UNRESOLVED_IMPORT] Could not resolve '../../../../tailwind.config'` in Themes.tsx, then `.cjs` parse errors. Root cause: `vinext init` renamed tailwind.config.js→.cjs (type:module); Themes.tsx imports it extensionless and Vite doesn't resolve `.cjs`; importing a `.cjs` into the bundle trips vite-plugin-commonjs vs rolldown's CJS classification. Change: rewrote tailwind.config.cjs → **tailwind.config.mjs (real ESM: import/export)**; colors.js left CJS (ESM default-imports it); added `.cjs` to `resolve.extensions` (defensive). Status: FIXED (1 source file converted + config). Tailwind 3.4.1 auto-discovers .mjs config.

4. BLK-7 RESOLVED — symptom: build `Rolldown failed to resolve "!raw-loader?esModule=false!…webpack-shim.js" from templateRSC.ts`. Root cause: webpack inline raw-loader syntax (RSC Sandpack), unsupported (vinext drops next.config `webpack`). Change: converted all 6 raw-loader `require()`s → Vite `?raw` imports in **src/components/MDX/Sandpack/templateRSC.ts** (4 local + 2 explicit-relative node_modules paths for react-server-dom-webpack & next compiled react-refresh). Status: FIXED (1 source file). NOTE: makes the build resolve; the RSC playground's *runtime* behavior in-browser is still unverified (see Open questions).

5. BLK-8 OPEN (vinext gap) — symptom: `/`, `/index`, `/index.html` and `/_next/data/<id>/index.json` all HTTP 404 → serve the 404 page (og:title "Not Found"); all non-root pages 200. Root cause: react.dev's homepage is the OPTIONAL catch-all `[[...markdownPath]]` with empty params (getStaticPaths emits `{markdownPath: []}` for content/index.md); vinext converts it to `/:markdownPath*` but does NOT serve the empty-params root. Workaround (explicit src/pages/index.js) conflicts with Next's optional-catch-all routing in the BASELINE. Status: OPEN — candidate fix: split into required catch-all `[...markdownPath].js` + explicit `index.js` (valid in both Next & vinext). Being attempted next.

DEV-ONLY (not build/serve blockers) — `vinext dev` SSR module-runner does not CJS-interop UMD/CJS deps on-demand: `classnames` → `window is not defined`, `parse-numeric-range` → `exports is not defined`. The BUILD + `vinext start` path bundles via rolldown with full CJS interop and is unaffected (verified: those pages serve 200 under `vinext start`). So this is a `vinext dev` quirk, not a feasibility blocker. Partial mitigations tried (optimizeDeps include, ssr.noExternal) help per-dep but full dev parity would need enumerating deps or a vinext dev fix.

Result: the page SSRs (200, h1 "RSC Sandbox Test") and all Sandpack EDITORS render with code, but EVERY preview panel is BLANK — the in-browser RSC pipeline throws. Console: 12× `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` in an `async Promise.all`, sourced to the `CustomPreset-*.js` chunk. Root cause localized: NOT react.dev's own source (no Promise.all/.length there) → it is inside the bundled `react-server-dom-webpack-client` + the hand-written `__webpack_require__` shim — the RSC Flight client fails resolving a client-component chunk through the shim. Ruled out: empty `?raw` imports (all RSC infra strings — webpack-shim, 892KB worker-bundle, rsdw-client — confirmed present in the build) and a stale worker bundle (regenerating worker-bundle.dist.js via `node scripts/buildRscWorker.mjs`, which `vinext build` does NOT run, changed its hash but did NOT fix the runtime). This is the "biggest re-engineering item" from the verified context, confirmed: needs real re-engineering of the in-browser RSC client/shim wiring (version-sensitive to react-server-dom-webpack@19.2.4); NOT fixed by the build-level `?raw` change alone. (Did not separately run under `next dev`, which is where upstream ships this dev-only feature — so framed as a vinext re-engineering item, not a claim that vinext regressed a verified-working baseline.)

## Deployment (parked)
PARKED per non-goals — NOT attempted. Readiness notes only:
- `vinext init` did NOT generate wrangler.jsonc / worker/index.ts at v0.1.8; a CF deploy would need those (and `vinext deploy`, which is on the NEVER-RUN list).
- The fs-dependent endpoints that pass LOCALLY (api/md, llms.txt reading src/content at request time; generateRssFeed writing public/rss.xml) work because `vinext start` runs on Node WITH a filesystem. On Cloudflare Workers there is NO fs — these would need prerendering to static assets or a bundled content manifest (verified-context items 4 & 7). This is the single biggest deploy-only gap.
- The build emits an on-demand SSR server, not 222 prerendered static pages; CF deploy would want SSG-to-assets or ISR for performance/cost.
- Native libs pulled in by vinext deps (satori/yoga/resvg for OG images) are auto-stubbed only at deploy per vinext docs — untested.
- errors/[errorCode] remote fetch + downloadFonts would need build-time prerender/caching for Workers.
- dist is ~56MB; bundle-size/Workers limits unevaluated.

## Open questions / upstream gaps
- **VINEXT GAP (BLK-8, worked around):** vinext does not serve the OPTIONAL catch-all `[[...slug]]` empty-params root `/` — it 404s. Worked around by splitting into a REQUIRED catch-all `[...slug]` + explicit `index.js` (valid in both Next & vinext) + null-safe `context.params?.markdownPath`. Candidate UPSTREAM ISSUE to file against cloudflare/vinext: "optional catch-all `[[...slug]]` does not match `/`".
- **VINEXT DEV GAP (BLK-5):** `vinext dev` SSR module-runner does not CJS-interop UMD/CJS deps on-demand (classnames `window`, parse-numeric-range `exports`). `vinext build`+`start` are fine. Candidate upstream issue: "dev SSR module runner: CJS/UMD deps with IIFE-wrapped module.exports throw under SSR".
- VERSION GAP: react.dev Next 15.1.12 vs vinext targets Next 16.x — vinext ran the Next-15 app without a forced version bump; no version-specific failure observed in the build/serve path. Risk did NOT materialize for the tested surface.
- next.config.js `webpack` block: `[vinext] next.config option "webpack" is not yet supported and will be ignored` (confirmed at boot+build). The shims it provided (use-sync-external-store/shim→react, esquery→min, raf/process NormalModuleReplacement, eslint IgnorePlugin) are DROPPED. Build only WARNS (util/assert/path externalized for the in-browser ESLint). NOT re-expressed yet — only needed for the in-browser ESLint / RSC Sandpack playground, which are client-only and unverified. If those break in-browser, re-express as vite resolve.alias + define + a raf/process shim.
- The 2 node_modules `?raw` imports in templateRSC.ts use explicit relative paths into node_modules; brittle to dependency layout but build-resolved.
- raw-loader→?raw is Vite-only: a parallel `next build` on the modified tree would now fail on templateRSC.ts (expected migration divergence; clean-clone baseline already captured as PASS).
- compileMDX `new Function` eval and prepareMDX default-import warning — work now but are fragile; worth a closer look for production.
- (adversarial-found, minor) `vinext start` reads compiled MDX from `./node_modules/.cache/` at serve time (server log: "Reading compiled MDX for /index|/learn from ./node_modules/.cache/"). Locally fine; note that serving relies on build-time cache artifacts being present (relevant to a clean/CI serve and to a Workers deploy where that cache must be bundled or content pre-rendered).

## Loop-2: hardening pass (post-publish, branch main-vinext)
A read-only multi-agent sweep (full-site render + redirects + images + fonts + client console + config/warnings + completeness critic, each adversarially verified) found 11 confirmed issues. Full-site sweep: **222/225 routes serve HTTP 200** (the 3 non-200 are by design, e.g. /errors/generic is a fallback template). Fixes applied + items recorded below.

### Fixed (verified on `vinext start`)
- **Redirects** — all 51 vercel.json redirects were 404ing (vinext doesn't read vercel.json; Vercel applies them at its edge). Re-expressed via `next.config.js` `async redirects()` mapping `vercel.json`. Verified: internal 308/307 (`/reference`→`/reference/react`, `/link/invalid-hook-call`→`/warnings/...`), external destinations (legacy.reactjs.org, 18.react.dev), and hash fragments all work. The `/link/*` paths appear in React's runtime warning messages, so this was user-facing.
- **next/image fixed-width 400** (local mitigation) — the uwu logo's `<Image width={63}>` (TopNav) and `width={313}` (HomeContent) made vinext emit a single width-descriptor srcSet (`w=63`/`w=313`) that the `/_next/image` optimizer 400s, producing a failed `fetchPriority=high` preload in every page `<head>`. Snapped to allowed widths (64; 384 with proportional height 196). Verified: head now references w=64/w=384 (both 200); no more w=63/w=313. (Root bug is upstream — see below.)
- **Font cache headers** — added `next.config.js` `async headers()` for `/fonts/:path*` immutable cache (mirrors vercel.json's only headers rule). NOTE: vinext *appends* rather than replaces its default `Cache-Control: max-age=3600`, so the response carries two Cache-Control headers (minor vinext quirk — recorded below).
- **StrictMode** — `next.config.js reactStrictMode:true` is recognized but not enforced by vinext; wrapped `_app.tsx` in `<StrictMode>` to preserve intended dev checks (no-op in production).
- **Self-host fonts** — upstream `index.css`/`Seo.tsx` hardcode `https://react.dev/fonts/`, so the fork would pull all 38 fonts from the upstream production domain. Rewrote the 38 `@font-face` srcs + 9 preloads to relative `/fonts/`, and wired `scripts/downloadFonts.mjs` into `build:vinext` (public/fonts is gitignored — a build artifact, per upstream). Verified: `/fonts/Optimistic_*` + `/fonts/Source-Code-Pro-*` serve 200, homepage head preloads are relative, zero `react.dev/fonts` residual. The immutable headers() above now applies to them.
- **In-browser ESLint linter** (live rules-of-hooks / exhaustive-deps markers in editable Sandpacks) — was fully broken: `runESLint()` returned `{fatal:true, message:"Parsing error: <x> is not a function"}` for ALL input (the dropped next.config `webpack` block had aliased two things vinext loses). Root-caused with a temporary in-chunk probe: **espree parses fine; the throw is post-parse**, first in eslint-scope's `assert()` (`r is not a function`), then in `esquery.parse` (`r.parse is not a function`). Two fixes in `vite.config.ts`: (1) serve `assert`/`node:assert` as a **virtual CommonJS module** (a plain `resolve.alias` to a file fails — `.cjs` is rejected by rolldown after vite-plugin-commonjs injects `export`, and a `.js` with `module.exports` bundles as ESM so `require('assert')` gets a non-callable namespace; rolldown's native CJS detection on the virtual module's `module.exports` makes require return the callable); (2) alias `esquery`→ its CJS build `esquery/dist/esquery.min.js` (its ESM `module` entry is default-only). Verified via the real `runESLint` export: valid code → `[]`, conditional hook → real `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` diagnostic; page loads with 0 console errors.

### Recorded for upstream (cloudflare/vinext) — no clean local fix
1. **next/image fixed-width srcSet** — for fixed-width Images (no `sizes`/`fill`) vinext emits a width-descriptor srcSet at the literal `width`, and `/_next/image` 400s any width not in deviceSizes/imageSizes (verified: w=63/313→400, w=64/384→200). Upstream Next snaps to allowed sizes / rounds up. `width={63}` is valid Next usage. (Locally mitigated by snapping widths.)
2. **Static-file MIME map** — vinext serves `.xml` and `.webmanifest` as `application/octet-stream` (CONTENT_TYPES table in `static-file-cache.ts` lacks them); bodies are byte-correct. Affects `/rss.xml`, `/site.webmanifest`, `/browserconfig.xml`. No repo escape hatch (headers() doesn't cover Content-Type of public files).
3. **experimental.reactCompiler ignored** — `next.config.js experimental.reactCompiler:true` is silently dropped (vinext drives the transform via oxc, not babel; verified: zero `_c(N)`/compiler-runtime in any app chunk). Parity/perf regression only (functionally correct). vinext should run babel-plugin-react-compiler or at least warn.
4. **headers() append-not-override** (minor) — a `next.config.js headers()` rule is appended after vinext's default `Cache-Control`, yielding two Cache-Control headers rather than overriding.

- **Trim the in-browser ESLint chunk** — the dropped next.config `IgnorePlugin` made rolldown bundle all ~284 core ESLint rules into the lazy `runESLint` chunk though only react-hooks rules are enabled. Added a `vite.config.ts` `pre` plugin that stubs bare `eslint/lib/rules/*` modules → `export default {}` (react-hooks rules come from a different package and are untouched). Verified correctness-neutral: the linter still flags `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` and passes valid code. Chunk: **1.17 MB → 542 KB** (−54%).

### Known-broken, deferred (needs dedicated work)
- **RSC Sandpack playground** (loop-1) — builds + SSRs + editors render, but the preview panels stay blank. IMPORTANT re-characterization (loop-2): this page is **dev-only** (`<SandpackRSC>` is used ONLY in `src/content/learn/rsc-sandbox-test.md`, which is in `devOnlyPages` — so it is NOT a public react.dev feature, just an internal experiment), and the RSC sandbox executes inside a **cross-origin external bundler** (`sandpack-bundler-4bw.pages.dev`, the SAME bundler the standard Sandpack uses and which renders fine), fed react.dev's RSC infra files via templateRSC. CORRECTION to the loop-1 diagnosis: the "12 console errors" attributed to RSC (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')` in an `async Promise.all`) were largely the **broken ESLint linter** crashing on THIS page's editors via `useSandpackLint` → `runESLint` (CodeMirror runs lint sources in a Promise.all) — now that the linter is fixed, the RSC page loads with **0 console errors**. The remaining failure is the preview rendering nothing — a SILENT failure inside the cross-origin bundler (not introspectable locally; the infra files ARE bundled correctly and the worker bundle was regenerated without effect). Net: low priority (dev-only, not user-facing) + not a tractable local fix (runs in an external bundler); would need dedicated work on the in-browser RSC infra (worker-bundle / webpack-shim / react-server-dom-webpack version matching). Left as-is.
- **Trim 1.17 MB linter chunk** (minor optimization, OPTIONAL) — the dropped next.config `IgnorePlugin` means rolldown bundles all ~284 core ESLint rules into the lazy `runESLint-*.js` chunk (1.17 MB) though only react-hooks rules are enabled. A `vite.config.ts` rolldown plugin (resolveId stub of bare `eslint/lib/rules/*` files → `export default {}`) would shrink it; correctness-neutral. Pure size win on a lazy chunk (no first-paint cost) — the linter itself now works (see Fixed), so this is optional polish.

## Loop-2 second sweep (fresh angles + regression-guard)
8 read-only investigators (interactive Sandpack, search+nav, html/a11y, hydration, content edge-cases, feeds/SEO, regression-guard, completeness-2), each adversarially verified. **11 raw → 9 confirmed. ZERO regressions, ZERO major/blocking.** All 222 content pages render 200; search, client nav, hydration all clean. The regression-guard re-verified every loop-1/loop-2 fix still holds (redirects, uwu widths, font cache, StrictMode, self-hosted fonts, ESLint linter, trimmed chunk).

Crucially, **every confirmed finding is pre-existing UPSTREAM react.dev behavior (component/content/config), not a vinext-port regression** — so per the "record upstream changes" rule they are recorded here, NOT patched into main-vinext (which stays the clean vinext delta). They'd be upstream react.dev PRs.

Findings (all minor/cosmetic):
1. (react.dev source) `/404` & `/500` emit `og:image=/images/og-undefined.png` → HTTP 404 social card. `Page.tsx:132` builds `/images/og-${section}.png`; 404.js/500.js pass no `section`. Fix: pass `section="unknown"` (or guard `section ?? 'unknown'`). Also `Seo.tsx:41` default `og-default.png` is a latent dead 404.
2. (react.dev source) Duplicate SVG `id`s — IconCanary/IconExperimental hardcode `id="Shape"`/`id="noun-labs-..."` (unreferenced → delete), IconNote `clipPath id` (referenced → `useId()`). HTML-conformance only.
3. (react.dev content) Blog raw `<img>` missing `alt` (perf_tracks screenshots in 2 blog .md files). WCAG 1.1.1 A.
4. (react.dev source) No skip-to-content link anywhere; `<main>` lacks an id. WCAG 2.4.1 A (SR users have landmark nav; affects keyboard-only).
5. (react.dev source/config) `api/md` markdown variant is `public,max-age=3600` but lacks `Vary: Accept` (RFC 9111 shared-cache correctness). Add `res.setHeader('Vary','Accept')`.
6. (react.dev source) Page-title `<h1>` anchor emits `href="#undefined"` on every MDX page (anchor is `display:none`). Cosmetic. Gate `Heading.tsx:35` on `id`.
7. (vinext upstream, KNOWN) node-origin `/_next/image` is pass-through (no resize/transcode, no `Vary`). Documented limitation; the real CF Workers deploy optimizes via `env.IMAGES`, so origin-only.
8. (local-fixable, LOW value) static `/_next/static` JS/CSS served uncompressed — `vinext({precompress:true})` would emit .br/.gz. NOT applied: the CF edge already compresses (and it'd just bloat the Workers upload); only a self-hosted node origin benefits.

**Net: the vinext port is solid.** No new vinext bugs; remaining items are upstream react.dev hygiene (minor) + a known origin-only image/compression gap that the Cloudflare edge handles in production.
